note: Failures remain in attempt denominators; p95 is withheld unless >=20 measured timing samples. Trace fields count allowlisted logical events and observed resolver counter snapshots only; they do not represent HTTP request totals. Concurrent phase duration samples are not additive. Per-attempt RSS is omitted because available child RSS is a lifetime high-water mark. A later host-network smoke with the same Bacc fixture and binary succeeded. The failed timings are invalid for performance conclusions.
